Independent integer matrix identities 63x63 and exact 30-degree Gegenbauer recurrence passed. Finite checks do not substitute for moment decay proof.

final_claim: On 126 antipodal normalized E7 roots of S6, full Gram spectrum has 63 antipodal zeros and five parity-sector levels 2(1+16u)[7], 2(1-2u)[56] for odd k, and 2(1+32u+30v)[1],2(1+4u-5v)[27],2(1-4u+3v)[35] for even k, u=P_k(1/2), v=P_k(0); rank 1,7,27,56,62 at k0..4, full63 for all k>=5, sharp consecutive surjectivity from degrees 5 and 6.
limitations: Full 126 roots with probability-sphere orthonormalization only; no arbitrary subset or noisy interpolation bounds.
Infinite positivity is analytical, not verified by finite 30-degree test alone.
